全局录制代理 · 所有 HTTP 往来: Global recording proxy · all HTTP traffic
把渗透任务目标拆解成若干独立、可验证的子目标。: Breaks a pentest goal into independent, verifiable sub-goals.
读取态势、判定目标，只在确有未覆盖的新方向时补充探索意图（每任务一个规划循环）。: Reads the situation, judges goals, and only adds exploration intents when there is genuinely uncovered ground (one planning loop per task).
人机接口：观察进展，把人的意图落成 hint 或高优先级意图。: Human interface: watches progress and turns operator intent into hints or high-priority intents.
领取一条意图执行，把发现的事实/漏洞写回知识图谱后停止。: Claims one intent, executes it, writes the resulting facts and findings back into the graph, then stops.
独立渗透 agent：一人从侦察→找攻击面→深入利用→验证→收尾走完整条链，自己: Standalone pentest agent: runs the entire chain from recon to attack surface to exploitation to verification to wrap-up, planning, executing and adversarially verifying on its own.
漏洞详细报告撰写：发现漏洞时自动触发，查取证据与执行过程后写 Markdown: Detailed vulnerability reports: triggered automatically when a finding appears, gathers evidence and execution history, then writes a Markdown report back.
从漏洞详情手动启动，读取原证据并保存独立复测结论。: Started manually from a finding; reads the original evidence and stores an independent retest conclusion.

规则或模型作出审批决定后，记录将显示在这里。: Records appear here once a rule or model makes an approval decision.
支持全等与模糊匹配的域名 / IP / URL，以及 CIDR 网段；默认内置模: Supports exact and fuzzy domain / IP / URL matching plus CIDR ranges; government (.gov / .gov.cn) and education (.edu / .edu.cn) sites are blocked fuzzily by default.
全 Agent 共享的格式 / 模型 / 限速配置。点击卡片编辑，星标为当前激活: Format, model and rate-limit settings shared by all agents. Click a card to edit; the starred profile is the active one.

系统工具的描述/绑定，以及自定义工具(command/script/http): System tool descriptions and bindings, plus custom tools (command / script / http)
为已登记漏洞补绑经核实的真实 HTTP 流量。finding_id 使用独立漏洞: Attach verified real HTTP traffic to a registered finding. finding_id is the standalone finding record ID, not an exploration node ID. A batch either fully succeeds or fully fails; re-referencing does not overwrite existing notes. Attaching marks existing reports as needing an update; do not re-probe or duplicate the finding just to attach traffic.
创建一个 MCP 服务器(stdio/http/sse)。创建后其工具需按 ag: Create an MCP server (stdio / http / sse). Afterwards its tools must be granted per-agent visibility.
创建一个新 skill(写 SKILL.md，agentskills.io 规范: Create a new skill (writes SKILL.md, agentskills.io spec). name accepts lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
读取当前复测会话关联的漏洞证据快照、复测状态、补充说明与当前任务约束。无参数，只: Read the finding evidence snapshot, retest status, notes and current task constraints bound to this retest session. Takes no arguments and only reads this session.
读指定任务的探索图总览(同 graph_overview：资产计数/fronti: Read the exploration-graph overview of a given task (same as graph_overview: asset counts / frontier / findings / coverage). Pass task_id to choose the task.
看指定任务里某个 work(意图)的执行过程：get_task_worker_t: Inspect the execution of one work (intent) in a given task: get_task_worker_trace(task_id, intent_id) returns a step summary; pass step_ids=[...] to fetch the full content of those steps (at most 5 at a time; extra ids are ignored).
取本任务或直接关联任务某条意图(work)的最终输出结论。关联任务结果带 sou: Get the final output of an intent (work) in this task or a directly linked task. Linked-task results carry source_task_id / inherited=true and are read-only. A normal finish returns its summary; a stopped or failed work returns its last output up to the point it stopped.
(探索链路图)探索态势蒸馏摘要：资产计数、无接口的站点、frontier、发现、: (Exploration graph) Distilled situational summary: asset counts, sites without endpoints, frontier, findings, hints (strategic notes from the human or main agent that must be folded into new intents). Call this first when planning.
终止一条正在运行的意图(work)。用于叫停跑偏/无意义的探索；被终止的意图标记: Stop a running intent (work). Use it to halt exploration that has gone off track or is pointless; the intent is marked stopped and is not reclaimed automatically. Check get_worker_output first to see what it is doing.
列出本任务的目标节点及其状态（open/met），用于判断是否达成。: List this task's goal nodes with their status (open / met) to judge whether the goal is achieved.
读指定任务的确认漏洞(含 flag/PoC；每条带 id/task_id/int: Read confirmed findings of a given task (including flag / PoC; each carries id / task_id / intent_id / vulnclass / severity / summary / status). Pass task_id to choose the task.
列出指定任务里跑过哪些 work(意图) + 各自步数，用于发现哪些 work: List which works (intents) ran in a given task and how many steps each took, to decide which are worth inspecting with get_task_worker_trace.
暂停指定任务(停止其 planner/worker 循环)。: Pause a given task (stops its planner / worker loops).
当你判断某个发现/事实证明了某个目标达成时调用：把证据节点连到目标节点，并标记目: Call when a finding or fact proves a goal is met: link the evidence node to the goal node and mark the goal met.
为当前复测会话保存唯一结论；原漏洞证据与报告保持不变。会话成功结束且结论为 fi: Store the single conclusion for this retest session; the original evidence and report stay untouched. When the session finishes successfully with conclusion fixed, the finding status becomes fixed automatically; other conclusions leave it unchanged. Provide evidence from the checks actually performed; when you cannot confirm, state the blocking reason.
记录确认的漏洞，用 evidence 提供命令输出、日志等可验证证据。任务上下文: Record a confirmed finding; supply verifiable evidence such as command output or logs via evidence. In a task context pass the current intent_id. The returned finding_id is the standalone finding record ID, finding_node_id is the exploration node ID (keep that node number on the first line).
在指定任务里按关键字搜索所有 work 的执行过程(返回命中步骤摘要 + int: Search the execution history of all works in a given task by keyword (returns matching step summaries plus intent_id).
新建一个子任务并启动探索引擎，返回 task_id。用于把一件事(如一道题/一个: Create a subtask and start its exploration engine, returning task_id. Use it to dispatch something (a challenge, a target) as an independent task. parent_ref is optional: pass the parent task id from the current orchestration to link them.
按 id 取一条已抓流量的请求/响应原文（过大会截断）。配合 traffic_s: Fetch the raw request / response of a captured traffic record by id (truncated when large). Use together with traffic_search to avoid repeating curl.
修改一个已有的自定义工具(按 key)。: Modify an existing custom tool by key.
修改一个已有的 MCP 服务器(按 id)。: Modify an existing MCP server by id.
写/覆盖某个 skill 内的一个文件(默认 SKILL.md)。用于修改技能内: Write or overwrite a file inside a skill (SKILL.md by default). Use it to edit skill content or add scripts and references.
